reason: Checked against the source. restore_game_zp has one caller (render.6502 line 563, JMP), save_game_zp one (line 338). Every write anywhere in src to &9F (top_palette_value), &A0 (firing_frame), &B6 (delta_low/first_mover/target) is in logic code in game.6502 (to_title_screen, start_game, initialise_colours_loop, add_player_bullet, set_firing_frame, set_first_mover, search_for_target, add/subtract_delta..., c1_walk, adjust_same_page, ru_cross) or shield.6502's rewind (logic). None of these is reached from render between 338 and 563: render's callees are its own routines, the sky/kind-cache/compiled code, and check_if_mover_is_on_screen, which writes nothing. No indexed or aliased zero-page write reaches them, and the symbol dump has no other name at those addresses. The interrupt (irq1_handler, sfx50) writes none of them. &B0/&B1: in the renderer only history_to_view and buffer_to_view write them. view_to_buffer slot 2 (line 348) saves them after save_game_zp with nothing writing them in between; each history_to_view (apply_entries) is followed by .scrolled's buffer_to_view slot 2; after that, put_on and player_done only read them. So at restore they already hold the saved values. The removed LDA zp_save+21 is dead (the next LDA sets A and NZ again). The LDA zp_save+17 on line 120 becomes dead but stays harmless. The only DEBUG_FULLREDRAW difference is a BRA. HUD_RUPTURE code is not on this branch. The change only frees room under ANDY, and the code after it (render_bss_zero, shield, sky_off) is not raster-timed and has no fixed addresses; any page-crossing effect is the gate's speed check to judge. Recount: 10 instructions removed, 3+4+3+4+3+4+3+4+4+3 = 35 cycles, 2+3+2+3+2+3+2+3+3+2 = 25 bytes (4 load/store pairs, the store of &9F, the dead load, and the &B6 pair).
